environment: Happy DOM with a minimal Canvas 2D pixel-write recorder

checks.name: Tutorial contains twelve lessons at level one
Role buttons select without counting an action
Tab and numeric shortcuts select the heroes
Directional movement starts an animation and locks action buttons
Undo interrupts animation without a stale frame
Reset interrupts animation and restores the tutorial
Completed keyboard movement updates pixels and teaching feedback
Undo button restores the last movement
Level picker exposes all eight initialized rooms
Restart returns to the initial tutorial
No JavaScript exceptions during the targeted checks

limitations: DOM and JavaScript checks only; no real-browser layout, visual review, audio or GPU rendering.
Canvas records the actual pixel buffers written by the app, without reproducing its rendering logic.
The browser Option constructor is supplied as a minimal shim because this Happy DOM version omits it.
Only initial-room actions and level selection are exercised; no campaign solution, solver or uniqueness check.
